result.brief: 提出首个运动-骨架统一基础模型 MoSk，用自监督掩码运动建模与关节名嵌入学习跨骨架格式的共享表征，并通过表征对齐提升运动生成质量。
result.reason: Self-supervised masked motion modeling builds shared motion-skeleton representations with joint-name embeddings, and representation alignment improves motion generation—directly a representation-learning contribution.
